No search-volume tool: Nepali users search mostly in English or romanised Nepali; Devanagari queries returned Nepali news, not products. csvRows are the research tool’s (US-indexed) results for “फुड ट्रक नेपाल अनलाइन अर्डर”, a close variant of the primary keyword.
decisions: Spelling: Nepali writes फुड (no nukta, short उ) — not Hindi फ़ूड. Keep Nepali loan spellings: किचेन (not किचन), कमिसन (not कमीशन), मेनु, बिलिङ/बुकिङ with ङ, अनलाइन (not ऑनलाइन — Nepali does not use ऑ).

Digits: Nepali press writes Devanagari digits (२०८१) and the app’s Intl formatting renders ne-NP numbers in Devanagari, so typed numbers in copy should be Devanagari too; exceptions: “2026” kept ASCII in comparison.meta.title / comparison.h1 per the SEO rule (२०२६ if the checker allows), URLs, e-mails, codes.
Pay at Hatch: “पिकअप गर्दा भुक्तानी” (feature) / “ट्रकमै भुक्तानी” (label). Avoid “क्यास अन डेलिभरी” (Foodmandu’s COD). At the truck people mostly pay by Fonepay/eSewa/Khalti QR or cash.
Messaging: Viber is widely used in Nepal alongside WhatsApp; the WhatsApp auto-reply feature may matter less here (unverified, Low).
Order button: no prescribed wording found (Consumer Protection Act 2075; E-Commerce Act 2081 — disclosure dafa 6, contract formation dafa 7). Market norm “अर्डर गर्नुहोस्” / “अर्डर पुष्टि गर्नुहोस्”.
